create_webhook_subscribe: create a dynamic webhook subscription with hermes webhook subscribe using a name, events, and delivery target
list_webhook_subscriptions: list all dynamic webhook subscriptions configured via hermes webhook list
remove_webhook_subscription: remove a dynamic webhook subscription by name using hermes webhook remove
test_webhook_delivery: test a webhook subscription by sending a test POST with HMAC-SHA256 signature via hermes webhook test
check_webhook_enabled: check whether the webhook platform is enabled and display setup instructions if not
